scale_definitions.irritation_risk: Estimated potential for irritation in a typical rinse-off formula, not an individual prediction
scale_definitions.chemical_reactivity: Formulation-level pH sensitivity, oxidation, or compatibility concern
scale_definitions.comedogenicity: Low, medium, high, or unknown; ingredient-only estimates are not definitive

ingredients.name: Salicylic Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: Activity depends on pH and free-acid fraction
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Validate stability in acidic formulations; excessive exfoliation can irritate

ingredients.name: Glycolic Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: Exfoliation depends on pH and concentration
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Avoid stacking multiple irritating exfoliants without a validated formulation

ingredients.name: Lactic Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: Activity depends on pH and concentration
ingredients.compatibility_notes: High concentrations or low pH may irritate sensitive skin

ingredients.name: Mandelic Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: Activity depends on pH and concentration
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Assess combined exfoliant load

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: Used to adjust pH; concentrated or low-pH exposure may irritate
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Evaluate final product pH rather than judging by its presence

ingredients.name: Ascorbic Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: L-ascorbic acid stability and activity depend on pH
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Protect from oxidation; check packaging and formula stability

ingredients.name: Niacinamide
ingredients.ph_notes: Generally compatible with mildly acidic to neutral skincare formulas
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Avoid extreme pH and heat during formulation; do not automatically flag AHA/BHA combinations as incompatible

ingredients.name: Azelaic Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: Solubility and delivery depend on the formulation
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check dispersion, solubility, and stability in the finished cleanser

ingredients.name: Gluconolactone
ingredients.ph_notes: Performance depends on formulation pH and hydrolysis
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check final pH and total exfoliant load

ingredients.name: Lactobionic Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: Acidity and performance depend on concentration and final pH
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Evaluate formula stability and tolerance

ingredients.name: Benzoyl Peroxide
ingredients.ph_notes: Not primarily a pH-adjusting ingredient
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Can oxidize susceptible ingredients and bleach fabrics; validate all combinations

ingredients.name: Retinol
ingredients.ph_notes: Stability depends on the complete formulation
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Often more practical in leave-on products than cleansers; avoid assuming rinse-off delivery is effective

ingredients.name: Bakuchiol
ingredients.ph_notes: No universal target pH based on this ingredient alone
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Assess solubilization, stability, and botanical sensitivity

ingredients.name: Zinc PCA
ingredients.ph_notes: Solubility and stability depend on pH
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check chelators and ingredients that may complex zinc

ingredients.name: Sulfur
ingredients.ph_notes: Compatibility depends on sulfur form and formula
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check odor, suspension stability, and potential dryness

ingredients.name: Tea Tree Oil
ingredients.ph_notes: No specific target pH from the ingredient alone
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Oxidation may increase sensitization risk; fragrance allergy is possible

ingredients.name: Witch Hazel
ingredients.ph_notes: Depends on extract and formulation
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Alcohol-containing extracts may increase dryness

ingredients.name: Willow Bark Extract
ingredients.ph_notes: Not equivalent to a standardized salicylic acid dose
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check extract standardization and salicylate sensitivity

ingredients.name: Licorice Root Extract
ingredients.ph_notes: Depends on extract and solvent
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Botanical composition varies by supplier

ingredients.name: Centella Asiatica Extract
ingredients.ph_notes: No universal target pH
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Confirm preservative compatibility and extract quality

ingredients.name: Green Tea Extract
ingredients.ph_notes: Polyphenol stability depends on pH and oxygen exposure
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Protect from oxidation and verify extract standardization

ingredients.name: Aloe Vera
ingredients.ph_notes: Depends on extract and complete formula
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Preservation is essential for water-containing aloe formulas

ingredients.name: Colloidal Oatmeal
ingredients.ph_notes: Generally compatible with mildly acidic to neutral formulas
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check suspension, microbial preservation, and oat allergy history

ingredients.name: Allantoin
ingredients.ph_notes: Check solubility and crystallization across the formula's pH range
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Can crystallize if the concentration or processing is unsuitable

ingredients.name: Panthenol
ingredients.ph_notes: Generally suited to mildly acidic skincare formulations
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check stability during heating and long-term storage

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.ph_notes: Broad formulation compatibility
ingredients.compatibility_notes: High levels can alter viscosity and sensory feel

ingredients.name: Hyaluronic Acid
ingredients.ph_notes: Polymer stability depends on pH, molecular weight, and processing
ingredients.compatibility_notes: High heat or extreme pH can affect polymer integrity

ingredients.name: Sodium PCA
ingredients.ph_notes: Generally compatible with mildly acidic to neutral formulas
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Electrolytes may affect surfactant viscosity and polymer thickening

ingredients.name: Urea
ingredients.ph_notes: Stability depends on formulation and storage
ingredients.compatibility_notes: May sting compromised skin; check concentration and stability

ingredients.name: Ceramide NP
ingredients.ph_notes: Depends on delivery system and complete formula
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Requires suitable lipid dispersion or delivery system

ingredients.name: Squalane
ingredients.ph_notes: Oil phase; pH is not directly applicable
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Requires suitable emulsification or solubilization in a cleanser

ingredients.name: Jojoba Oil
ingredients.ph_notes: Oil phase; pH is not directly applicable
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check oxidation, emulsification, and individual sensitivity

ingredients.name: Shea Butter
ingredients.ph_notes: Oil phase; pH is not directly applicable
ingredients.compatibility_notes: May feel heavy in some formulas; finished-product behavior matters

ingredients.name: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride
ingredients.ph_notes: Oil phase; pH is not directly applicable
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check emulsification and formula stability

ingredients.name: Dimethicone
ingredients.ph_notes: Not directly pH-dependent in ordinary use
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Check dispersion and compatibility with surfactant systems

ingredients.name: Cocamidopropyl Betaine
ingredients.ph_notes: Works across a formulation-dependent pH range
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Some users react to impurities or related compounds

ingredients.name: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate
ingredients.ph_notes: Check solubility and stability in the selected formula
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Can be difficult to dissolve in some liquid formulations

ingredients.name: Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate
ingredients.ph_notes: Performance depends on pH and surfactant blend
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Validate viscosity, mildness, and compatibility with other surfactants

ingredients.name: Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate
ingredients.ph_notes: Check solubility and surfactant performance at target pH
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Formula performance depends on surfactant blend and electrolyte level

ingredients.name: Decyl Glucoside
ingredients.ph_notes: Check stability under strongly acidic conditions
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Can irritate or cause contact allergy in some individuals

ingredients.name: Lauryl Glucoside
ingredients.ph_notes: Check stability in strongly acidic formulations
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Mildness depends on concentration and the complete surfactant system

ingredients.name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate
ingredients.ph_notes: Long-term stability can be affected by strongly acidic conditions
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Irritation depends on concentration, contact time, and surfactant blend

ingredients.name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate
ingredients.ph_notes: Check final pH and surfactant concentration
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Can strip skin lipids and irritate; generally a poor default for sensitive-skin recommendations

ingredients.name: Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate
ingredients.ph_notes: Validate stability and mildness in the full formula
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Can be drying in some formulas despite its effective cleansing

ingredients.name: Sodium Chloride
ingredients.ph_notes: Not a meaningful acid/base active
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Can thin rather than thicken a surfactant formula beyond its salt curve

ingredients.name: Disodium EDTA
ingredients.ph_notes: Chelation performance depends on pH
ingredients.compatibility_notes: May alter the availability of metal ions and influence preservative or antioxidant systems

ingredients.name: Phenoxyethanol
ingredients.ph_notes: Performance depends on the complete preservative system
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Assess concentration, local regulations, and individual sensitivity

ingredients.name: Sodium Benzoate
ingredients.ph_notes: More effective in acidic formulations
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Confirm the finished product's preservative efficacy with testing

ingredients.name: Potassium Sorbate
ingredients.ph_notes: Preservative effectiveness decreases as pH rises
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Often requires a broader preservative strategy; test the finished formula

ingredients.name: Methylisothiazolinone
ingredients.ph_notes: Follow jurisdiction-specific restrictions
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Known contact allergen; do not recommend as a preferred ingredient for sensitive skin

ingredients.name: Fragrance / Parfum
ingredients.ph_notes: Depends on the fragrance components
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Prefer fragrance-free options for users reporting fragrance sensitivity

ingredients.name: Menthol
ingredients.ph_notes: No universal target pH
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Cooling sensation is not evidence of cleansing efficacy; may irritate sensitive skin

ingredients.name: Limonene
ingredients.ph_notes: No meaningful pH benefit
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Oxidized limonene can be sensitizing; flag for fragrance-sensitive users

ingredients.name: Linalool
ingredients.ph_notes: No meaningful pH benefit
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Oxidation products may cause contact allergy in susceptible users

ingredients.name: Propolis Extract
ingredients.ph_notes: Depends on extract and carrier
ingredients.compatibility_notes: Potential contact allergen; flag known propolis or bee-product sensitivity

ingredients.name: Charcoal
ingredients.ph_notes: No intrinsic exfoliating pH target
ingredients.compatibility_notes: May adsorb formulation ingredients; claims about deep detoxification should not be assumed

ingredients.name: Kaolin
ingredients.ph_notes: Check final pH and mineral impurities
ingredients.compatibility_notes: May increase dryness and requires appropriate suspension stability
